title: TutorialCore Guide Manual
summary: Understand cards, hints, triggers, progress marks, recommendations, and mistake coaching.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: TutorialCore is the adaptive help layer. It listens for progress, triggers, and mistakes, then surfaces cards or hints without forcing every player into a fixed lesson path.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Read new cards when they unlock, but treat them as route coaching rather than chores. Useful help often appears after a concrete action or mistake.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Perform actions, earn progress marks, unlock cards, follow hints, and use recommendations to pick the next useful objective when the route feels unclear.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Cards, hints, flows, tooltips, triggers, guide mode, and mistake coaching work together so help appears close to the thing the player just did.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Wiki guide books report progress when opened. Terminal, HoloMap, Lens, PowerGrid, WorldCore, and MissionCore all publish player actions that can guide help.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If help feels quiet, check that TutorialCore is loaded and that the expected addon is present for the action you are trying.
